description: A stereo waveshaper that folds a signal and then holds it at a chosen level, with separate fold targets for the two sides

params.text: Sets how hard the signal is driven into the shaper, silence to ten times
Attenuverts the gain CV before it is added to the gain knob
Sets the level the folded signal settles at once it is driven past the fold, -5V to 5V for both sides together
Attenuverts both clip CVs before they are added to the clip knob

inputs.text: Changes the drive, added to the gain knob through its attenuverter and clamped to 0 to 10
Changes the settling level of the left side, added to the clip knob through its attenuverter; with only the right jack patched, that one feeds this side too
Changes the settling level of the right side, added to the clip knob through its attenuverter; with only the left jack patched, that one feeds this side too
The left signal to be shaped
The right signal to be shaped; with nothing patched it carries the left signal

outputs.text: The shaped left signal, clamped to -10 to 10V
The shaped right signal, clamped to -10 to 10V

menu: Clipping Mode: Convergent, Symmetric — Convergent settles both halves of the wave at the clip level; Symmetric settles the positive half there and the negative half at its mirror image
Supersampling — evaluates the shaper eight times per sample and averages the result, then filters it, which reduces the aliasing a hard fold produces
Bandlimit Filter — puts the shaped signal through a low-pass filter set by the cutoff slider below it
Filter Cutoff — a slider setting the corner of the bandlimit filter, shown in kilohertz against a 44.1kHz rate

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the right clip jack.
inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the left clip jack.
inputs.4:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the left input.
